messages:
Maya (marketing): Noticed a spike in unassigned HubSpot leads around 11:05 PDT, funnel looks like enrichment property `lead_enriched` never set. Can ops/RevOps take a look?
Jorge (revops): Checking. HubSpot webhook delivery shows 504 from enrich-api /api/v2/enrich for some batched payloads. HS retries but our RR lambda checks enrichment immediately on first arrival.
Lina (growth): Do we have any high-value leads stuck? Any webinar signups?
Maya (marketing): Quick sample: ~28 webinar registrants + 10 trial signups without owner. No enterprise flags.
Tom (ops): Suggest immediate mitigation: 1) add temporary router rule to classify leads w/out `lead_enriched=true` into `rr-overflow` queue; 2) bump claim window from 120s -> 300s via feature flag; 3) annotate routed leads with `fallback_reason=enqueue_enrich` and `enrich_incident_id=1754321987` so reps know why. Thumbs?
Ravi (sales-eng): Thumbs. Please add visible HS note so AEs know not to cold-reject.
Jorge (revops): I'll update mapping to include `original_owner` if present and create a cohort tag `enrich-latency-1754321987` for monitoring. Also want to capture `time_to_owner` metric.
leadflow-bot: alert: enrich-api /api/v2/enrich 5xx went from 0.2% -> 9.8% (10:58 - 11:12 PDT). Auto-backoff triggered.
Tom (ops): Quick patch command: 
```
PATCH /feature-flags/lead-routing
{ "claim_window_seconds": 300 }
```
Rolling canary at 5% for 2m then 25% -> 100% if stable. Also pushing router change: if `lead_enriched` != true -> route->rr-overflow and set properties.
Lina (growth): Can we surface a subtle banner in HubSpot list view for reps: "Leads routed via fallback due to enrichment latency"? Want to avoid duplicate outreach.
Maya (marketing): I'll draft short FYI blurb for #sales-ops and pause any automated webinar nurture sequences that assume enrichment tags.
deploy-bot: feature-flag update scheduled by tom.ops: ff-lead-routing-1754321987 (canary 5%).
Tom (ops): Canary started at 11:18 PDT. Monitoring: https://grafana.redwood/d/leadflow/rr-routing?orgId=1&panel=4
Jorge (revops): Adding dashboard panels for first_touch_time and first_owner_delay for cohort tag. Also popping an alert if average time_to_owner > 6m for cohort.
Ravi (sales-eng): On the overflow RR pool, please include header `X-Routed-Via: fallback_enrich` in the webhook so downstream tools can filter.
Tom (ops): Will do. Also enabling a short-term sampling log for 1% of fallback leads to capture raw payloads for debugging.
Maya (marketing): Draft comms: "Temporary routing change: we've activated a fallback route for leads while enrichment recovers. You may see leads with tag `fallback_reason=enqueue_enrich` — please treat them as normal leads. We'll update when enrichment is cleared." Approve?
Ravi (sales-eng): Approve. Add note: "Do not pause outreach solely due to fallback tag"
leadflow-bot: deploy-bot: canary applied. ID ff-1754321987-canary by tom.ops.
Tom (ops): Update: canary healthy at 11:26 PDT. Moving to 25%. Enrich API 5xx rate trending down to 3.1%.
Jorge (revops): Created incident INC-2026-4821 and linked dashboards. Will own the postmortem and SLA proposal: consider default claim_window 300s and improve idempotency on enrich retries.
Lina (growth): Once resolved, can we run a quick A/B to see if 300s improves lead-to-owner conversion before making permanent change?
Jorge (revops): Good idea. I'll add an experiment flag and baseline window metrics.
Tom (ops): 100% rollout at 11:33 PDT. Router fallback live. Keeping feature flag at 300s for 90 minutes then reassess.
Maya (marketing): Sent comms to #sales-ops and paused webinar follow-ups. Thanks team.
leadflow-bot: note: incident INC-2026-4821 created for enrich-api regression.
Maya (marketing): Please keep this thread updated with rollback or perf improvements.
